## Invariant Foundations
- I1: Existence does not imply permission (strip ambient authority).
- I2: Monotonic convergence under join-semilattice properties.
- I3: Bounded execution ceiling: tau <= 11.99 ms, heap allocation M_alloc = 0, stack bound S_max <= 4096 B.
- Mechanical Invariant: Independent braking via M_stop; software airlock delay ceiling Delta_t_max <= 13.19 ms.
- Robust Margin Invariant: Discrete rational witness gamma in Q bounding sensor noise (noise_bound) and asynchronous loss via Bellman-Gronwall reachability.
- Operational Constraint: C_ops = 0 (universal zero-maintenance, zero-drag deployment invariant).
